description: The pie chart titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)" represents the distribution of token routing in a federated learning system. The chart is divided into three slices, each representing a different routing method. The largest slice, which occupies the majority of the chart, is labeled "LOCAL" and is colored green, accounting for 97.4% of the total. The second slice, labeled "LLM" and colored red, represents 3.9% of the total. The smallest slice, labeled "EDGE_P2P" and colored blue, accounts for 1.6% of the total. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are displayed inside the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
